premises.text: Web3 games have become an important part of the web3 ecosystem and can provide alternative funding sources for developers
premises.evidence_span: web3 games have become a very important part of the web3 ecosystem over the last couple of years starting with the rise of axie infinity which has a game economy that's whose value is measured in like billions of dollars

premises.text: Integrating web3 into games allows for more engaging and immersive experiences with player communities
premises.evidence_span: it's a way to build much more engaging and immersive games with the collaboration of their player communities than ever existed before

premises.text: Game economies in web3 require different management strategies compared to traditional game economies
premises.evidence_span: as soon as you build a web3 game your game economy becomes a real economy

premises.text: Maintaining a healthy game economy is a significant challenge for web3 game developers
premises.evidence_span: your biggest problem is how do i make sure my economy doesn't crash how do i keep the economy healthy

premises.text: Participants in the economy should be able to produce value within that economy
premises.evidence_span: the first principle is that the people who are participating in the economy should be able to produce in that economy

premises.text: Taxes create value in an economy
premises.evidence_span: the second principle is that there should be you know taxes create value

premises.text: Moonstream provides features to help games maintain healthy economies
premises.evidence_span: we offer a variety of features on our platform that help games maintain healthy economies

premises.text: Security measures are necessary to protect the economy from bad actors
premises.evidence_span: we run security bots as well to make sure that the economy is protected against bad actors

value.text: Web3 games can maintain healthy economies through effective management and community engagement

notes: Traction metrics and specific pricing details are excluded as they do not represent premises.
